description: Recent Subtensor chain events, optionally filtered by pallet, event name, block range, or pagination. Requires TAOSTATS_API_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_subtensor_block_events when you need events of a single Bittensor Subtensor block by block; crypto_subtensor_registrations when you need recent neuron registration events across all subnets. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
